prompts.cast: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single professional game character design presentation board for 桃园乱斗, funny Three Kingdoms mobile arena roguelite. Image 1 is style reference only: preserve its thick dark brown outlines, flat warm cel shading, huge expressive heads, tiny bean feet, short rounded tunics, short curved arms and actual gripping hands. Ignore the old weapons in the reference. Cream paper background, dark jade title band, restrained gold dividers. Wide 4 by 2 grid with generous clean spacing, exactly 8 clearly separate full body chibi figures, no action FX obscuring silhouettes. Top row: 赵云, silver helmet with blue plume, blue-white short armor, self-confident pretty boy smirk, holding a slender silver spear, tiny baby-peach-shaped knapsack; 孔明, black scholar cap, white robe teal sash, slightly smug sleepy eyes, oversized feather fan held firmly, tiny wheel-shaped jade ornament, absolutely no full size legs; 吕布, black and burgundy tiny armor, two absurdly long curved pheasant feathers forming expressive eyebrows, silver crescent Fangtian halberd; 董卓, comically round pudgy body and enormous gold belt, tiny purple robe, clutching a roast drumstick and ceremonial mace. Bottom row: 袁绍, ostentatious gold helmet red tassel and tiny purple cape, pompous fan of command slips; 曹操, narrow cunning eyes, black-blue short robe, jade sword and red command token; 周瑜, handsome smug scholar-general, white short armor and red sash, a feather fire fan, a faint soot mark on cheek for humor; 孟获, very rounded strong body, leaf-green fur trim, exaggerated tooth necklace, small bronze club, comic stubborn frown. Label each character with only the specified Chinese name. Title: 桃园乱斗·英雄与群雄. Each silhouette readable at 90px. No photorealism, no muscular realistic legs, no MMO detailing, no brands, no watermarks. This is a concept sheet, not a sprite sheet or final runtime asset.
prompts.troops: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one enemy unit visual design board for 桃园乱斗, same comic chibi Three Kingdoms style as Image 1 (reference only). Thick chocolate outlines, big heads, minimal tiny feet, short bodies, warm flat cel colors, simplified shape readability. Cream paper background with dark jade headings and neat individual panels. Wide 4 columns by 3 rows, exactly 12 distinct enemy figures or tiny wheeled machines, centered with clean spacing. Row1: 黄巾农兵 with hoe and floppy yellow scarf; 朴刀兵 small sword and dark green cloth helmet; 大盾兵 broad rectangular navy shield with comic stern eyes peeking over; 长枪兵 clearly long spear and gray metal pointed cap. Row2: 弩手 holding a wooden crossbow (not a bow); 虎豹骑 a small heavy black-and-red armored rider on a squat toy-like horse; 井阑弩车 a compact two-wheel wooden ballista with large horizontal bow and three bolt channels, one tiny helmeted operator; 投石车 a compact sling catapult and round stone. Row3: 火油兵 big clay oil pot and red head wrap; 火枪手 a teal-clothed chibi musketeer holding a recognizable old matchlock, no modern assault rifle; 神威炮车 a small bronze cannon on sturdy red wheels, tied red tassel and comic goggles on operator; 南中象兵 a stubby cute war elephant with tiny stubborn rider and pale green war paint. Exact short name labels beneath, title 黄巾到南中·兵种概念. Different roles distinguishable by silhouette, weapons and headgear even in grayscale. Faction colors yellow/navy/crimson/green, same archetype stays anatomically reusable. No realistic troops, no gore, no giant battle scene, no large background decorations.
prompts.weapons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one collectible weapon concept board for 桃园乱斗. Image 1 is style reference only: thick brown linework, compact rounded forms, warm metal highlights, jade and burgundy bindings, clear cel shading, readable at 48px. Do not copy obsolete green beans or rolling pin. Cream paper background, dark jade title ribbon and restrained gold grid. A wide 4 by 3 grid, exactly 12 clean isolated large weapon icons, slight consistent diagonal, no character hands, no stats, no particles hiding weapon shape. Row1 双股剑: a paired gold-green straight sword set; 青龙偃月刀: iconic broad curved green-dragon guandao with long brown shaft and red tassel; 丈八蛇矛: long black shaft with clear wavy serpent spear point; 方天画戟: symmetric silver crescent side blades and central spear point, purple-red tassel. Row2 龙胆银枪: narrow blue-white silver spear with blue tassel, not a halberd; 青釭剑: straight steel sword with restrained blue hilt and simple gold fittings; 倚天剑: larger gold-hilt straight sword with imperial dark blue scabbard motif; 七星宝刀: short jeweled saber with seven small gem studs. Row3 诸葛连弩: compact wooden repeating crossbow with magazine on top; 白羽扇: a rounded white feather fan with jade handle and teal binding; 太平要术: old golden scroll book with small yellow talisman; 七星灯: seven tiny warm lamps arranged as a compact star-like ritual weapon. Exact name labels only under each icon. Title 三国名器·武器概念. No modern UI clipping, no thin unreadable detailing, no photoreal metal.

Image 1 is a troop art reference only; reproduce its small funny wooden 3-bolt ballista icon accurately as the selected enemy. Match existing cream paper, dark jade green panels, deep brown outlines, gold trims and small vermilion accents, very legible modern simplified Chinese UI text. This is a practical game interface, not a decorative poster. Safe margin 44px, compact top bar title 三国图鉴, close/back top left, top tabs 敌兵 / 武器 / 技能 with 敌兵 selected. Left 56% has filters 全部 / 步兵 / 远程 / 骑兵 / 器械 and a 4x3 grid of unit portrait cards, selected ballista has gold border. No repeated gigantic character illustration. Right 40% warm paper detail card: title 井阑弩车, tag 器械 · 架空演绎, medium sized selected ballista illustration, two small mode pills 标准值 / 本章值 with 标准值 selected. Accurate data labels in two tidy columns exactly: 生命 156; 移速 62; 伤害 1颗心; 射程 680; 攻击间隔 2.6秒; 前摇 0.75秒; 每轮 3箭; 弹速 420. Beneath, readable concise mechanic text: 三箭齐射，装填时脆弱. Footer note: 标准演练基准，章节另有倍率.
